name: Cable Seated High Row
steps: Sit tall facing a high pulley with knees softly bent and feet braced securely.
Reach up and forward to grip the handle with both arms extended under tension.
Drive your elbows down and back to pull the handle toward your lower chest or ribs.
Squeeze your shoulder blades briefly, then extend your arms back up under control.
tips: Keep your torso upright instead of rocking backward.
Pull your shoulders down away from your ears as the handle moves toward you.
